housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of SEK 10,316.92 for a one-bedroom apartment in Gothenburg city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Gothenburg). The City of Gothenburg housing guide says deposits are usually one or two months' rent and identifies Boplats Göteborg as the municipal housing agency (https://goteborg.se/wps/wcm/connect/ed9c0192-a9e1-4adc-9a7b-5417837c20a5/250516-002-B725+S%C3%A5+s%C3%B6ker+du+bostad%2C+broschyr+ENGELSKA_2025.pdf?MOD=AJPERES).

banking.summary: Swedbank's official newcomer checklist requires completed application forms, identity documentation, a Swedish Tax Agency coordination-number extract if assigned, and evidence explaining the account's purpose or source of funds (https://www.swedbank.se/en/private/become-a-customer/become-a-customer-without-mobile-bankid). SEB's official guides require a passport for EU/EEA applicants and a passport plus Swedish residence-permit card for applicants from outside the EU/EEA (https://seb.se/privat/bli-kund/new-in-sweden/eu-and-eea-citizens and https://seb.se/privat/bli-kund/new-in-sweden/outside-eu-and-eea).
required_docs: Valid passport or approved EU/Schengen national identity document
Swedish Tax Agency register extract showing a coordination number, if assigned
Evidence of account purpose or funds, such as an employment contract, salary statement, financial overview, or current-bank statement
For non-EU/EEA applicants to SEB, a Swedish residence-permit card

schools.summary: The Gothenburg-region schools directory lists ISGR with IB Primary Years and Middle Years programmes and IHGR and Hvitfeldtska with the IB Diploma Programme; it also identifies Swedish national curricula where applicable (https://www.movetogothenburg.com/live/schools-and-preschools/).

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer planning to live in Sweden for at least one year should notify the Swedish Tax Agency through the Moving to Sweden service and, after arrival, attend a booked in-person identity check at a Swedish state service centre (https://www.skatteverket.se/movingtosweden).
legal_admin.registration_step: Notify the Swedish Tax Agency of the move using the Moving to Sweden e-service, then book and attend an in-person identity check at a Swedish state service centre after arrival.

tax_finance.summary: The Swedish Tax Agency assigns a Swedish personal identity number when a newcomer is first entered in the Population Register; people staying under one year may instead need a coordination number (https://www.skatteverket.se/movingtosweden and https://www.skatteverket.se/servicelankar/otherlanguages/inenglish/individualsandemployees/livinginsweden/personalidentitynumberandcoordinationnumber.4.2cf1b5cd163796a5c8b4295.html).
tax_finance.tax_id_name: Swedish personal identity number (personnummer); coordination number (samordningsnummer) may apply for stays under one year

transport.summary: Västtrafik is the public-transport network; its current temporary fare page lists a 30-day adult Zone A pass at SEK 445, or SEK 305 for registered Gothenburg residents buying the subsidised ticket in Västtrafik To Go (https://www.vasttrafik.se/biljetter/rabatter/snart-halveras-priset-pa-manadsbiljetter/). The Swedish Transport Agency says valid EEA licences remain valid and may be exchanged by permanent residents, while non-EEA licences generally cease to be valid after one year of Swedish registration and only licences from the UK, Faroe Islands, Switzerland, or Japan may be exchanged under specified conditions (https://www.transportstyrelsen.se/en/road/driving-licences/i-have-a-driving-licence/). Försäkringskassan says newcomers staying at least one year should register with the Swedish Tax Agency; once registered, they receive medical and dental care on the same terms as other residents (https://www.forsakringskassan.se/english/moving-to-working-studying-or-newly-arrived-in-sweden/move-to-sweden).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid EEA licence remains valid in Sweden and may be exchanged by a permanent resident. A non-EEA licence generally becomes invalid after one year of Swedish registration; only licences from the United Kingdom, Faroe Islands, Switzerland, or Japan may be exchanged under specified conditions.
transport.healthcare_registration: If staying at least one year, register in the Swedish Population Register through the Swedish Tax Agency; once registered, public medical and dental care is available on the same terms and standard patient fees as for other residents.
